title: spec review: S4b v6: stale-work detection before review — record when the goal branch moved across a task's surface after its base, optional rebase and re-gate behind [scheduler].stale_rebase, never discarding work (spec reviews T-0545, T-0547, T-0549 folded in; Planner-dispatched after three rounds)
spec:
Goal T-0503, brief .orchestrator/adaptive-parallelism-program.md section P12 (cheap deterministic checks; rebase/revalidate before expensive review when stale risk is high; never silently discard work; record stale events) and P14. Base goal/T-0503 with S3 v4 (T-0541) merged: daemon has schedlog, _load_scheduler_cfg returning {mode, soft_conflict_policy, max_wave}, waves, critical path; tests/test_daemon.py::test_scheduler_cfg_defaults asserts that exact dict. Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only. Tests are unittest.TestCase methods (the gate runs unittest discover).
Facts: daemon.gate skips tasks whose pipeline.gated_at is set, runs tests-green on a done execute task's worktree, and on green stamps gated_at with green_fields inside a `with bus.locked():` block, then (outside the lock, in the same try scope as report_merge/_open_reviews) merges directly (n_reviews == 0) or calls _open_reviews; clear_stage(tid, "gated_at", ...) removes the stamp so the task re-enters gate(); changed_paths(task) fails soft with None; failures.failure_kind classifies hold_reason stale_rebase_conflict as kind conflict, which auto_fix_round never treats as routine and decision.route sends to the Planner (hold_requires_planner); scorecard.parallelism already reads stale.jsonl rows by task, goal_id, risk == "high" and pipeline.stale_check.risk; merge.merge rebases onto the goal branch at merge time and marks conflicts failed with reason rebase_conflict.
1. gitutil: add class GitError(RuntimeError). moved_paths(base_ref, target_ref, cwd, git=...) -> sorted list of paths changed between the merge-base of the two refs and target_ref (git merge-base, then git diff --name-only, both with cwd=cwd, normally the task worktree); raises GitError on any git failure. Differs from changed_paths' None convention on purpose: the caller must distinguish "nothing moved" (empty list) from "git failed" (risk unknown); say so in the docstring.
2. _load_scheduler_cfg gains stale_rebase = False (bool) in its defaults and return dict; update tests/test_daemon.py::test_scheduler_cfg_defaults's expected literal; add [scheduler].stale_rebase = false to .orchestrator/pool.toml with a comment.
3. daemon.stale_check(task) -> {"base", "goal_head", "moved_count", "stale_paths", "risk"} (keep exactly these key names; scorecard reads risk): goal branch = the task's merge target; moved = moved_paths(task branch, goal branch, cwd=task worktree); surface = literal scope paths plus changed_paths(task) or []; stale_paths = moved entries equal to a surface literal or fnmatching a surface glob; risk none when empty, high when any stale path is also in changed_paths(task), else low; unknown when moved_paths raises GitError. Called from gate() after the locked gated_at stamp block has completed, outside bus.locked(), in the same try scope as report_merge/_open_reviews and before them; idempotent per head (skip when pipeline.stale_check.head equals the current head); stamps pipeline.stale_check = {base, goal_head, moved_count, stale_paths, risk, checked_at, head} and appends runs/sched/stale.jsonl {"ts","task","goal_id","base","goal_head","moved_count","stale_paths","risk","action"} (keep task, goal_id and risk names) with action "recorded". Never blocks the pipeline: any exception inside stale_check is caught, recorded as risk unknown, and gate proceeds.
4. When stale_rebase is true and risk is high (also outside bus.locked()): run git rebase <goal branch> inside the task worktree. On conflict: abort the rebase, clear_stage the gated_at stamp, hold the task with hold_reason "stale_rebase_conflict" and resume_hint {"conflicts": [...], "goal_head": ...}, action "rebase_conflict", return before reviews. This hold escalates to the Planner (kind conflict is never auto-fixed); the Planner authors a constraints.fix_round_for task that resolves the rebase in the worktree, after which gate() re-runs because gated_at is clear. On success: clear_stage the gated_at stamp so the next tick re-gates the rebased head before reviews, action "rebased", pipeline.stale_check.rebased_to = new head, return. merge.merge's own rebase stays as the final safety. No commit or branch is ever deleted.
5. README Pipeline paragraph: two sentences on stale checks and the stale_rebase switch, naming the hold reason and that it escalates to the Planner.
6. Tests: tests/test_gitutil.py::test_moved_paths_lists_files_changed_on_target_since_merge_base and ::test_moved_paths_raises_git_error_on_failure (new file, reuse the git sandbox helpers of tests/test_merge.py or tests/_harness.py); tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_check_none_when_goal_unmoved, ::test_stale_check_low_when_scope_overlaps_moved_paths, ::test_stale_check_high_when_changed_file_moved, ::test_stale_check_unknown_on_git_failure, ::test_stale_check_records_row_and_stamp_before_reviews, ::test_stale_rebase_conflict_holds_clears_gate_and_never_discards, ::test_stale_rebase_success_regates_before_reviews. Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_check_none_when_goal_unmoved, tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_check_low_when_scope_overlaps_moved_paths, tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_check_high_when_changed_file_moved, tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_check_unknown_on_git_failure and tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_check_records_row_and_stamp_before_reviews pass: after the green gated_at stamp and before reviews or a direct merge every execute task gets pipeline.stale_check (with risk) and one stale.jsonl row (task, goal_id, risk) with risk none, low, high or unknown; a git failure yields unknown and never blocks

tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_rebase_conflict_holds_clears_gate_and_never_discards and tests/test_daemon.py::test_stale_rebase_success_regates_before_reviews pass: with stale_rebase true a high-risk task is rebased and re-gated before reviews, or held with hold_reason stale_rebase_conflict, a conflicts resume_hint and no gated_at stamp; the default false changes nothing but the record; no commit or branch is deleted

tests/test_gitutil.py::test_moved_paths_lists_files_changed_on_target_since_merge_base and tests/test_gitutil.py::test_moved_paths_raises_git_error_on_failure pass; tests/test_daemon.py::test_scheduler_cfg_defaults asserts the defaults including stale_rebase false
full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 and the suite gains nine tests

risks.issue: "goal branch" is defined as "the task's merge target" but the spec doesn't spell out the parentless-task fallback (merge.merge uses "integration", not goal/<parent>, when t.get("parent") is falsy). If stale_check hardcodes f"goal/{parent}" without that fallback, parentless execute tasks will always hit GitError and report risk="unknown" -- safe (never blocks) but silently loses staleness coverage for that class of task.

suggested_spec_changes: In item 3, add one clause: for a parentless task, goal branch is "integration" (matching merge.merge's own target fallback), so moved_paths gets a resolvable ref instead of silently degrading to risk=unknown.
